decisions.reason: Clearly distinguishes clipboard draft and occurrence coordinates from detect TokenSpan coordinates, including chip expansion versus U+FFFC and normal text.
Locates snapshot.draft.length, explains empty-composer first success and later detect-span overshoot, and rejects the changed-composer toast as a real race.
Traces unconverted occurrence offset/length to consumeToken, the ignored false result, unconditional record deletion, and unavailable label from the same mismatch.
Derives the preceding-chip subtraction for both insert and removal, uses a one-character detect remove span, preserves draftRev, and gates record deletion on success.
Includes successive paste and removal/bookkeeping tests, but does not specifically test removing a chip while another preceding chip remains and asserting the other survives.
